description: This script manages Quality of Service (QoS) configurations, including network interface setup, class and rule management, and firewall rule integration, primarily for OpenWRT-based systems.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Adds kernel modules with conditional logic based on system capabilities.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Finds network interface name for a given interface, with different implementations depending on system.

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Constructs iptables rules based on matching criteria and options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Handles configuration callbacks for interface and classification settings.

methods.name: qos_parse_config
methods.description: Parses QoS configuration entries and sets up interfaces and class groups.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates and assigns class numbers to QoS classes.

methods.name: cls_var
methods.description: Sets class variables based on configuration.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generates traffic control rules using awk script.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes and configures a network interface for QoS, including traffic shaping.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Starts QoS setup for all configured interfaces.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds iptables rules for QoS classification and marking.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Starts QoS for a class group, including iptables rules and traffic control setup.

methods.name: start_firewall
methods.description: Initializes firewall rules for QoS management.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Removes QoS-related iptables rules and chains.
